marks.gloss_en: harlots adorn one another; Torah scholars, all the more so [should support one another] -- said as what people will say of a colleague who disowns a ruling he was counted in
טיהר בן יוחי בית הקברות! -- ben Yochai has purified a cemetery!
you were with us and counted with us -- a rebuke on the objector's standing, not a defence on the merits (= p_ilmalei_lo_hayita_imanu)

RSBY to the old man: had you not been with us, or been with us and not been counted with us, you would speak well; now that you were with us and counted with us, they will say: harlots adorn one another -- Torah scholars, all the more so?!
איכא איניש דידע דאיתחזק הכא טהרה? -- כאן קיצץ בן זכאי תורמסי תרומה; עבד איהו נמי הכי
RSBY: is there anyone who knows that purity was established here? an old man: here ben Zakkai cut lupines of teruma
מפני מה אמרו אין טומנין בדבר שאינו מוסיף הבל משחשכה? גזרה שמא ירתיח
אמר ליה אביי: אי הכי, בין השמשות נמי ניגזר! -- if the concern is boiling, the decree should reach twilight too
אמר ליה: סתם קדירות רותחות הן -- ordinary pots are boiling [at twilight] (= p_rava_stam_kedeirot_rotchot)
one may not insulate [hot food] in a thing that does not add heat once it is dark
מנא הני מילי? אמר קרא: ופקדת נוך ולא תחטא (kind svara: no support kind names a verse answering a source question)
וקיימתה מסברא -- Rav Ashi fulfilled it from his own reasoning
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: the verse says 'and you shall know that your tent is in peace, and you shall visit your habitation and shall not sin' (Job 5:24)
הא גופא קשיא: 'at nightfall' -- yes, at doubtful nightfall -- no; and then it teaches: at doubtful nightfall one makes an eruv! (kind svara under protest: no kind names an internal contradiction)
the stam's inference from the opening clause: 'at nightfall' -- yes; at doubtful nightfall -- no [no longer 'have you made the eruv?']
לא קשיא: כאן בעירובי תחומין, כאן בעירובי חצרות (= p_reisha_techumin, p_seifa_chatzerot)
Rav: here (the opening clause) -- eruvei techumin
מה נפשך: if twilight is day, the latter acquires and the former not; if it is night, the former acquires and the latter not! (kind svara under protest: no kind names a dilemma-objection)
בין השמשות ספיקא הוא, וספיקא דרבנן לקולא (= p_bhs_safek, p_safek_derabanan_lekula)
twilight is a doubt
three things a person must say in his home on Shabbat eve at nightfall: have you tithed? have you made the eruv? light the lamp
Rava: two told one 'go, make an eruv for us'; for one he made it while still day, for the other at twilight; the first's eruv was eaten at twilight, the second's after dark -- both acquired the eruv
